meta.method: Each row below was re-checked by the auditing session against the linked page via web search / page fetch on 21 Oct 2026. 'Confirmed' means every checked field matched the linked source. 'Contradicted' means at least one published value disagrees with the linked source. Rows are a sample chosen to cover every build and the weakest-looking entries; this is not a claim that unsampled rows were re-verified.

legend.partial: fixture fields match but narrative/other fields could not be confirmed or are wrong
legend.unverifiable: no official page found to confirm or deny

checks.official_says: EuroLeague: Round 7 on 22 Oct features Anadolu Efes v Beşiktaş. EuroLeague TV schedule lists 17:30 (CET) = 20:30 local Istanbul time. Turkish press (Son Dakika, 20 Oct) and eurobasket standings list Efes 2-4 and Beşiktaş 3-3, and the venue as Turkcell Basketbol Gelişim Merkezi (Basketball Development Center), not Sinan Erdem Dome.
checks.note: Records in the prediction appear inverted, the timezone label is wrong (20:30 is TRT, not CET), the venue disagrees with the broadcaster/press listing, and the published text contains an unedited self-correction. Row source is Wikipedia. Standings/venue confirmation comes from press, not the organiser — treat the venue as unverified rather than proven wrong.
